swordAttack.interpretation: The source contains authored torso and right-labelled arm motion, unlike the previous arm-only diagnostic. Actual anatomical hand ownership, retarget quality, ground contact and visual acceptance must still be verified in Unity. Local quaternion excursions are not world-space attack direction or acceptance.

readOnlyGlbInspection.countCaveat: Current downloaded non-RM export contains 43 animations. Do not report advertised 120+ total across paid tiers or the older Defold example's 45 mixed-RM clip list as this archive's clip count.

usageBoundary: Animation donor only. Included body mesh is a rig/reference fixture, not replacement character art. Original Meshy body, clothing, 23-bone rig, weights, materials, LODs, equipment/loadout truth, gameplay and save remain unchanged by this intake.
